imu_still.instruction: Initialisierung geprüft. Controller 10 Sekunden flach und ruhig halten.

gyro_yaw.instruction: Gyro G1: 2 s Ruhe, 6 s langsam links/rechts um die Hochachse drehen, 2 s Ruhe.

gyro_pitch.instruction: Gyro G2: 2 s Ruhe, 6 s langsam nach vorn/hinten neigen, 2 s Ruhe.

gyro_roll.instruction: Gyro G3: 2 s Ruhe, 6 s langsam links/rechts rollen, 2 s Ruhe.

accel_left_right.instruction: Accel A1: 2 s Ruhe, 6 s sanft links/rechts verschieben, möglichst ohne Drehen, 2 s Ruhe.

accel_front_back.instruction: Accel A2: 2 s Ruhe, 6 s sanft vor/zurück verschieben, 2 s Ruhe.

accel_up_down.instruction: Accel A3: 2 s Ruhe, 6 s sanft auf/ab bewegen, 2 s Ruhe. Nicht schütteln.

motion_timing.heuristic: gyro norm > 100 raw counts continuously for >=250 ms; sample gaps <=40 ms

missing: independent angular reference or documented sensor sensitivity
signed mapping from every wire axis to controller/SDL axes
multiple known static poses to separate gravity, bias and per-axis gains
verified movement times/directions; cue times alone are insufficient

timestamp_limit.note: No invented device clock. Angle integration needs checked delivery intervals/latency.
